durabilityGate.title: Off-device archive required
durabilityGate.description: Too many fiscal events have not yet been transferred off this device. Spec §12 requires you to push an off-device archive before authoring any more sales. Acknowledge the gate to record this action in the audit log and continue for the next hour.
durabilityGate.phase2Note: Phase 2 will wire the actual archive transfer here. For now, acknowledging records an operator action and unlocks a one-hour grace window.
